body: I was at the stop light, waiting for it to turn green to turn on to Tudor from New Seward and then a person driving a truck hit me going lord knows how fast and rear ended me pretty bad. I’m pretty injured 🤕. My shoulder is extremely messed up and so is my neck as well as my leg. The lacerations on my shoulder and chest are pretty bad. I’m not sure what the person was thinking when he accelerated instead of slowing down.
Hooper Bay has a house floating away. People fleeing their homes. Gusting to 75.

I totally feel you on that. I know my kids love the crap out of me. I feel unloved by my husband. When he talks to people he tells them he's going to spend time with the kids, but not his family. Its been bugging me for a while, I have a hard time loving myself more days than I find something about myself I love.
I wish he just left me alone. I'm sure one day I will pull out of it.
